consequence.statement: Before upgrading, clusters using external workloads must have a cluster name and ID specified, or explicitly opt out of KVStoreMesh, because KVStoreMesh is now enabled by default.
consequence.remediation: Specify the cluster name and ID before upgrading, or explicitly disable KVStoreMesh.

original.statement: KVStoreMesh is now enabled by default; clusters using external workloads must set a cluster name and ID before upgrading, or explicitly opt out of KVStoreMesh.

decision.reason: [ev-b62da9c1ceb5] says that, because KVStoreMesh is now on by default, clusters with external workloads must have a Cluster name and ID set before upgrading, or must explicitly opt out of KVStoreMesh. That is a required operator step before the upgrade, which matches migration-required. [ev-12660f87be40] confirms the default change and the opt-out through Helm `clustermesh.apiserver.kvstoremesh.enabled=false`. The proposed statement and remediation stay within the evidence and do not claim a failure mode the text does not state.
